summary: Crown Castle Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of the sale of its fiber solutions business to Zayo Purchaser (Fiber Finco, LLC) and its small cells business to Arium Networks (Small Cells Holdco Inc.) for $8.5 billion in aggregate cash proceeds, subject to adjustments. The transaction closed on May 1, 2026, under a Stock Purchase Agreement dated March 13, 2025. A $1.0 billion share repurchase program was authorized. The board thanked departing COO Christopher Levendos, who resigned to join Zayo. The deconsolidation reduces Crown Castle’s asset base, and watch for deployment of proceeds and potential antitrust clearance follow-ups.
